passage:
A band used AI to create possible melodies for a new song. The program made many short tunes in seconds.
Most were boring. A few had interesting parts. The band chose one phrase, changed it, added human lyrics, and built a song around it.
When fans learned AI had been used, some were upset. The band explained that AI gave drafts, but humans made choices, played instruments, and shaped emotion.
The debate continued.
The song raised a modern question: when does a tool become a partner, and when does it become a shortcut?
Art may use new tools, but audiences still listen for human intention.
